text: In the mountains above Bergen, Norway, there is a valley called Isdalen — the Ice Valley. In late November 1970, it gave up one of the strangest cases in European criminal history.
say: In the mountains above Bergen, Norway, there is a valley called Isdalen — the Ice Valley. In late November nineteen seventy, it gave up one of the strangest cases in European criminal history.
asr: In the mountains above Bergen, Norway, there is a valley called Isdalen — the Ice Valley. In late November 1970, it gave up one of the strangest cases in European criminal history.

text: A woman was found dead on the valley floor. She had burned. And someone had carefully removed every trace of who she was — from her clothes, her belongings, and her luggage.
say: A woman was found dead on the valley floor. She had burned. And someone had carefully removed every trace of who she was — from her clothes, her belongings, and her luggage.

text: She carried no name. Instead she left the opposite of a confession: eight false identities, a coded notebook, and a set of clues so strange that investigators have argued about them for more than fifty years.
say: She carried no name. Instead she left the opposite of a confession: eight false identities, a coded notebook, and a set of clues so strange that investigators have argued about them for more than fifty years.

text: This is the file of the Isdal Woman. Not a story about who killed her. A story about a woman who erased herself — and the questions that erasure left behind.
say: This is the file of the Isdal Woman. Not a story about who killed her. A story about a woman who erased herself — and the questions that erasure left behind.
asr: This is the file of the Isdal Woman. Not a story about who killed her. A story about a woman who erased herself — and the questions that erasure left behind.

text: Bergen police opened the case under a dry bureaucratic label: number 134, of 1970. Half a century later, the file is still open.
say: Bergen police opened the case under a dry bureaucratic label: number one hundred and thirty four, of nineteen seventy. Half a century later, the file is still open.
asr: Bergen police opened the case under a dry bureaucratic label: number 134, of 1970. Half a century later, the file is still open.

text: The question at the centre of it has never changed. Who checked into Norway's hotels under eight different names — and why did she need all of them?
say: The question at the centre of it has never changed. Who checked into Norway's hotels under eight different names — and why did she need all of them?

text: It was a Sunday morning, the twenty-ninth of November 1970. A father and his two young daughters were hiking the foothills below the north face of Ulriken, one of Bergen's seven mountains.
say: It was a Sunday morning, the twenty ninth of November nineteen seventy. A father and his two young daughters were hiking the foothills below the north face of Ulriken, one of Bergen's seven mountains.
asr: It was a Sunday morning, the twenty-ninth of November 1970. A father and his two young daughters were hiking the foothills below the north face of Ulriken, one of Bergen's seven mountains.

text: The valley between the slopes had a second name — Death Valley — earned by medieval history and by accidents on its treacherous scree. That morning it lived up to neither. It simply held something no one expected.
say: The valley between the slopes had a second name — Death Valley — earned by medieval history and by accidents on its treacherous scree. That morning it lived up to neither. It simply held something no one expected.

text: Among the rocks, the family found the body of a woman. She was lying on her back. There was evidence of a small fire nearby. The front of her body and her clothing had been burned; her face could not be recognised.
say: Among the rocks, the family found the body of a woman. She was lying on her back. There was evidence of a small fire nearby. The front of her body and her clothing had been burned; her face could not be recognised.

text: The daughters were walked home. The police were called. Within hours, the valley floor had become a scene of evidence.
say: The daughters were walked home. The police were called. Within hours, the valley floor had become a scene of evidence.

text: Around her lay a strange inventory. An empty bottle of St. Hallvard liqueur. Two plastic water bottles. A plastic passport holder — empty.
say: Around her lay a strange inventory. An empty bottle of Saint Hallvard liqueur. Two plastic water bottles. A plastic passport holder — empty.
asr: Around her lay a strange inventory. An empty bottle of Saint Hallvard liqueur. Two plastic water bottles. A plastic passport holder — empty.

text: Rubber boots. A woollen jumper. A scarf. Nylon stockings. An umbrella. A purse, a matchbox, a watch, two earrings, and a ring.
say: Rubber boots. A woollen jumper. A scarf. Nylon stockings. An umbrella. A purse, a matchbox, a watch, two earrings, and a ring.

text: Beneath her body, a fur hat would later test positive for petrol. Around it, the traces of burned paper.
say: Beneath her body, a fur hat would later test positive for petrol. Around it, the traces of burned paper.

text: And one detail above all: on nearly every item, the labels, marks and name-tags had been removed or rubbed away. Not lost. Removed.
say: And one detail above all: on nearly every item, the labels, marks and name-tags had been removed or rubbed away. Not lost. Removed.

text: At the Gades Institute in Bergen, the post-mortem built a medical timeline. The woman had died from a combination of sleeping tablets and carbon monoxide.
say: At the Gahdes Institute in Bergen, the post mortem built a medical timeline. The woman had died from a combination of sleeping tablets and carbon monoxide.
asr: At the Gades Institute in Bergen, the post-mortem built a medical timeline. The woman had died from a combination of sleeping tablets and carbon monoxide.

text: Her blood held the equivalent of fifty to seventy Fenemal tablets — a barbiturate that brings sleep, then stops the lungs. Twelve more pills were found beside the body.
say: Her blood held the equivalent of fifty to seventy Fenemal tablets — a barbiturate that brings sleep, then stops the lungs. Twelve more pills were found beside the body.

text: Soot in her airways showed she was still alive as the fire reached her. A bruise on her neck could have come from a fall — or from a blow. The report could not say which.
say: Soot in her airways showed she was still alive as the fire reached her. A bruise on her neck could have come from a fall — or from a blow. The report could not say which.

text: Her dental work was so distinctive that investigators removed her teeth and jaw for examination. That decision would matter, decades later.
say: Her dental work was so distinctive that investigators removed her teeth and jaw for examination. That decision would matter, decades later.

text: Three days after the discovery, two suitcases were located at Bergen railway station, left behind as if their owner had simply stepped away.
say: Three days after the discovery, two suitcases were located at Bergen railway station, left behind as if their owner had simply stepped away.

text: Inside: clothing, shoes, wigs, make-up, eczema cream, maps and timetables. Coins from Belgium, Britain and Switzerland. A pair of ordinary glasses — and sunglasses whose partial fingerprints matched the dead woman.
say: Inside: clothing, shoes, wigs, make up, eczema cream, maps and timetables. Coins from Belgium, Britain and Switzerland. A pair of ordinary glasses — and sunglasses whose partial fingerprints matched the dead woman.

text: Sewn into the lining of one suitcase, police found five hundred Deutsche Marks — real money in 1970, left deliberately or forgotten.
say: Sewn into the lining of one suitcase, police found five hundred Deutsche Marks — real money in nineteen seventy, left deliberately or forgotten.
asr: Sewn into the lining of one suitcase, police found five hundred Deutsche Marks — real money in 1970, left deliberately or forgotten.

text: And again, the same signature. Every identification mark on every item — inside and out — had been cut away or filed off.
say: And again, the same signature. Every identification mark on every item — inside and out — had been cut away or filed off.

text: The trail led back through Bergen's hotels to the Hotel Hordaheimen. The woman had stayed there in mid-November 1970, in room 407.
say: The trail led back through Bergen's hotels to the Hotel Hordahimen. The woman had stayed there in mid November nineteen seventy, in room four oh seven.
asr: The trail led back through Bergen's hotels to the Hotel Hordaheimen. The woman had stayed there in mid-November 1970, in room 407.

text: Staff remembered a woman about five feet four, dark brown hair, small brown eyes, good-looking. She kept to her room. She seemed, one account says, to be on guard.
say: Staff remembered a woman about five feet four, dark brown hair, small brown eyes, good looking. She kept to her room. She seemed, one account says, to be on guard.

text: She told people she was a travelling saleswoman — sometimes an antiquities dealer. Witnesses noted wigs. More than one person remembered the smell of garlic.
say: She told people she was a travelling saleswoman — sometimes an antiquities dealer. Witnesses noted wigs. More than one person remembered the smell of garlic.

text: On the twenty-third of November she paid her bill in cash, asked for a taxi, and checked out. She was last seen alive that day. What happened in the six days after that is not recorded anywhere.
say: On the twenty third of November she paid her bill in cash, asked for a taxi, and checked out. She was last seen alive that day. What happened in the six days after that is not recorded anywhere.
asr: On the twenty-third of November she paid her bill in cash, asked for a taxi, and checked out. She was last seen alive that day. What happened in the six days after that is not recorded anywhere.

text: Her hotel registration forms read like a cast of characters. Genevieve Lancier of Leuven. Claudia Tielt of Brussels. Claudia Nielsen. Vera Jarle. Fenella Lorck. Elisabeth Leenhower of Ostend.
say: Her hotel registration forms read like a cast of characters. Genevieve Lancier of Leuven. Claudia Tielt of Brussels. Claudia Nielsen. Vera Jarle. Fenella Lorck. Elisabeth Leenhower of Ostend.

text: Eight or more names, on handwritten forms filled out in French and German. Occupations and birthdays changed from form to form. One thing never did: she always gave her nationality as Belgian.
say: Eight or more names, on handwritten forms filled out in French and German. Occupations and birthdays changed from form to form. One thing never did: she always gave her nationality as Belgian.

text: Later, investigators checked the addresses. Almost every street name on the forms was false — several, it turned out, did not exist at all.
say: Later, investigators checked the addresses. Almost every street name on the forms was false — several, it turned out, did not exist at all.

text: Many of the names were saints' names. Whether that was devotion, habit, or a private joke, no one has ever established.
say: Many of the names were saints' names. Whether that was devotion, habit, or a private joke, no one has ever established.

text: In one suitcase, police found a small notepad. Its pages carried entries in code — letters and figures in rows that looked like nonsense.
say: In one suitcase, police found a small notepad. Its pages carried entries in code — letters and figures in rows that looked like nonsense.

text: Investigators cracked it. The code was simple: letter substitutions that opened onto dates and place names. It was a travel log, written in a private shorthand.
say: Investigators cracked it. The code was simple: letter substitutions that opened onto dates and place names. It was a travel log, written in a private shorthand.

text: What the notebook establishes is a route. What it does not establish is a reason. The entries map where she went — not who she met, and not why she travelled.
say: What the notebook establishes is a route. What it does not establish is a reason. The entries map where she went — not who she met, and not why she travelled.

text: It is the pattern of a person managing her own secrecy. Analysts agree on that much. Beyond it, the code keeps its silence.
say: It is the pattern of a person managing her own secrecy. Analysts agree on that much. Beyond it, the code keeps its silence.

text: Reconstructed from the code, the receipts and the hotel forms, her last months look like this: Oslo. Trondheim. Stavanger. Then Bergen — twice — and at least one trip through Paris.
say: Reconstructed from the code, the receipts and the hotel forms, her last months look like this: Oslo. Trondheim. Stavanger. Then Bergen — twice — and at least one trip through Paris.

text: In Stavanger, a shoe salesman remembered selling rubber boots to a well-dressed woman. In Bergen, a witness overheard her speaking German with a man in a hotel. Others recalled Flemish, or careful, broken English.
say: In Stavanger, a shoe salesman remembered selling rubber boots to a well dressed woman. In Bergen, a witness overheard her speaking German with a man in a hotel. Others recalled Flemish, or careful, broken English.

text: She changed hotel rooms after checking in. She watched the street from windows, witnesses said. Every habit pointed the same direction: this was a woman practised at not being found.
say: She changed hotel rooms after checking in. She watched the street from windows, witnesses said. Every habit pointed the same direction: this was a woman practised at not being found.

text: The investigation ran for months and consumed enormous police resources. Interpol circulated the composite sketches across Europe.
say: The investigation ran for months and consumed enormous police resources. Interpol circulated the composite sketches across Europe.

text: No missing-person report matched her. No family ever came forward. In 1971, Bergen police closed the case with a verdict of probable suicide.
say: No missing person report matched her. No family ever came forward. In nineteen seventy one, Bergen police closed the case with a verdict of probable suicide.
asr: No missing-person report matched her. No family ever came forward. In 1971, Bergen police closed the case with a verdict of probable suicide.

text: The woman who could not be named was buried on the fifth of February 1971, in a zinc coffin, in Bergen's Mollendal cemetery. Sixteen police officers attended.
say: The woman who could not be named was buried on the fifth of February nineteen seventy one, in a zinc coffin, in Bergen's Mollen-dahl cemetery. Sixteen police officers attended.
asr: The woman who could not be named was buried on the fifth of February 1971, in a zinc coffin, in Bergen's Mollendal cemetery. Sixteen police officers attended.

text: The verdict settled the file. It never settled the argument.
say: The verdict settled the file. It never settled the argument.

text: Take the official verdict seriously, because the evidence allows it. The toxicology supports a self-administered overdose. The scene held no weapon and no sign of struggle.
say: Take the official verdict seriously, because the evidence allows it. The toxicology supports a self administered overdose. The scene held no weapon and no sign of struggle.

text: The erased identity fits one reading: a person preparing to disappear. Cutting labels, paying cash, false names — the logistics of someone who did not want to be traced, in life or in death.
say: The erased identity fits one reading: a person preparing to disappear. Cutting labels, paying cash, false names — the logistics of someone who did not want to be traced, in life or in death.

text: But it explains the method, not the planning. Why travel a thousand kilometres to die in a valley? Why the notebook of dates and places no one was ever meant to read?
say: But it explains the method, not the planning. Why travel a thousand kilometres to die in a valley? Why the notebook of dates and places no one was ever meant to read?

text: Other details pull the other way. The bruise on the neck. A position and a fire that a deeply sedated person may not have managed alone.
say: Other details pull the other way. The bruise on the neck. A position and a fire that a deeply sedated person may not have managed alone.

text: In 1991, a taxi driver came forward anonymously. He said that on that November day, a man had joined the woman in his cab for the ride to the railway station.
say: In nineteen ninety one, a taxi driver came forward anonymously. He said that on that November day, a man had joined the woman in his cab for the ride to the railway station.
asr: In 1991, a taxi driver came forward anonymously. He said that on that November day, a man had joined the woman in his cab for the ride to the railway station.

text: In 2005, a Bergen hiker reported a sighting from five days before the body was found: the woman, dressed for the city, walking ahead of two men in coats. He said he was told to forget it; no formal record was made.
say: In two thousand and five, a Bergen hiker reported a sighting from five days before the body was found: the woman, dressed for the city, walking ahead of two men in coats. He said he was told to forget it; no formal record was made.
asr: In 2005, a Bergen hiker reported a sighting from five days before the body was found: the woman, dressed for the city, walking ahead of two men in coats. He said he was told to forget it; no formal record was made.

text: None of this is evidence of murder. It is evidence of people who were never found — and of a scene that always allowed more than one story.
say: None of this is evidence of murder. It is evidence of people who were never found — and of a scene that always allowed more than one story.

text: Then there is the theory everyone has heard. The Cold War context: a woman with false names moving through a NATO country. The codes. The discipline. The silence.
say: Then there is the theory everyone has heard. The Cold War context: a woman with false names moving through a NATO country. The codes. The discipline. The silence.

text: Journalists noted that some of her movements coincided with missile testing areas on Norway's coast — and a fisherman placed her near one such zone. It is a suggestive pattern, and nothing more.
say: Journalists noted that some of her movements coincided with missile testing areas on Norway's coast — and a fisherman placed her near one such zone. It is a suggestive pattern, and nothing more.

text: Here is what the file does not contain: not one document placing her in any intelligence service. Not one witness naming an agency. Bergen police never adopted the spy theory.
say: Here is what the file does not contain: not one document placing her in any intelligence service. Not one witness naming an agency. Bergen police never adopted the spy theory.

text: It remains exactly what it was in 1970 — a story that fits the shape of the clues, but none of the facts in the file prove it. Hold it lightly.

text: In 2016, Bergen police reopened the case, and the media brought new attention. NRK commissioned six new sketches, shown to people who had actually seen her.

asr: In 2016, Bergen police reopened the case, and the media brought new attention. NRK commissioned six new sketches, shown to people who had actually seen her.

text: The BBC and Norway's NRK turned the case into the podcast Death in Ice Valley, and listeners around the world began sending new leads.
say: The B B C and Norway's N R K turned the case into the podcast Death in Ice Valley, and listeners around the world began sending new leads.
asr: The BBC and Norway's NRK turned the case into the podcast Death in Ice Valley, and listeners around the world began sending new leads.

text: The reinvestigation gathered what the 1970s could not: fresh interviews, digital restorations of the sketches, and the first full re-examination of the preserved evidence.

asr: The reinvestigation gathered what the 1970s could not: fresh interviews, digital restorations of the sketches, and the first full re-examination of the preserved evidence.

text: Modern forensics went to work on what 1970 had preserved. Isotope testing on her teeth — kept separately since the autopsy — placed her birth around 1930, in or near Nuremberg, in southern Germany.
say: Modern forensics went to work on what nineteen seventy had preserved. Isotope testing on her teeth — kept separately since the autopsy — placed her birth around nineteen thirty, in or near Nuremberg, in southern Germany.
asr: Modern forensics went to work on what 1970 had preserved. Isotope testing on her teeth — kept separately since the autopsy — placed her birth around 1930, in or near Nuremberg, in southern Germany.

text: The same analysis suggested she moved as a child to France, or the French-German border region — which matched earlier handwriting analysis pointing to a French education.
say: The same analysis suggested she moved as a child to France, or the French German border region — which matched earlier handwriting analysis pointing to a French education.

text: Her DNA pointed to a maternal line found in south-eastern Europe or south-western Asia. Genetic genealogist Colleen Fitzpatrick of the DNA Doe Project joined the effort.
say: Her DNA pointed to a maternal line found in south eastern Europe or south western Asia. Genetic genealogist Colleen Fitzpatrick of the DNA Doe Project joined the effort.

text: Even her dentist seemed to have been abroad: the dental work matched practices in central or southern Europe, East Asia — or South America. Every answer opened another map.
say: Even her dentist seemed to have been abroad: the dental work matched practices in central or southern Europe, East Asia — or South America. Every answer opened another map.

text: So strip away fifty years of folklore. Here is what the evidence supports: a woman in her thirties or forties, born around 1930, travelling alone under false names with great care.

text: Confirmed: the medical cause of death, the dates, the hotels, the aliases, the coded notebook, the 1971 verdict of probable suicide — and the 2016 reopening that changed none of it.
